name: Mori Shaonü ~ Zhen Na de Lingru Shengcun Riji
original_name: 末日少女 ～ 珍娜的凌辱生存日記
source:
The doom has come, you have to face the dark sides of humanity survive . Finding materials and foods, is the key to win this game, besides that, you can also build up the defense and recruit new partners to make you easier to win this game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE222913.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
末日已经降临，你必须面对人性的阴暗面并努力生存。寻找材料和食物是赢得这场游戏的关键；除此之外，你还可以建造防御设施、招募新的伙伴，让胜利更加容易。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE222913.html]DLsite English[/url]）
